description: The bar chart illustrates the ratio of incorrectly answered samples for three different language models: Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT, across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the ratio, labeled as "Ratio (%)", and the horizontal axis lists the categories. The ratio is measured on a linear scale ranging from 50% to 90%. In the Movies category, Llama3 has the highest ratio, close to 90%, followed by Qwen2 with a ratio slightly above 80%, and ChatGPT with a ratio around 70%. In the Songs category, Qwen2 has the highest ratio, approaching 90%, while Llama3 and ChatGPT have ratios around 80% and 60%, respectively. In the Basketball category, Llama3 has the highest ratio, slightly above 60%, Qwen2 has a ratio around 50%, and ChatGPT has the lowest ratio, close to 40%. The bars are color-coded with Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
